Local PDF runtime, pinned 2026-10-23

pdf-lib.esm.min.js: pdf-lib 1.17.1 ESM distribution, unchanged apart from
removing the sourceMappingURL comment for the unused debug map.
https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js
MIT license: PDF-LIB-LICENSE.txt

fontkit-bundle.js: @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 ESM plus pako 1.0.11.
https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1/dist/fontkit.es.js
Bundled with esbuild 0.28.0, platform browser, format ESM, minify true,
legalComments eof. No application logic or font glyphs were added.
Upstream MIT declarations: FONTKIT-LICENSE.txt
pako MIT/Zlib declarations: PAKO-LICENSE.txt; bundle retains dependency notices.

All files are served from this site. No remote CDN, analytics, image,
font endpoint, canvas screenshot, or print dialog is used to create a PDF.
